description: Defines classes and structures related to 3GPP network slice identifiers, including slice service type, slice differentiator, and combined NSSAI structure, with formatting support.

classes.name: slice_service_type
classes.description: Represents the Slice/Service Type (SST) as per 3GPP specifications, with methods to check if standardized or operator-specific.

classes.name: slice_differentiator
classes.description: Represents the Slice Differentiator (SD), with methods to check if default or set, and creation with validation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a slice_differentiator with validation.
